steps.code:
# Let's try near_side approach on bottle_plastic_middle and mystery_middle and bottle_glass_middle
for obj_name, target_pos, ref_obj in [
    ("bottle_plastic_middle", [5.42, -3.58, 1.02], "bottle_plastic1"),
    ("mystery_middle", [4.28, -3.55, 1.05], "bottle_glass2"),

]:
    g = primitives.call(name="ground_robocasa_visual_target", entity_name=obj_name)

        continue
    ev = g.output["evidence_handle"]
    r_g = primitives.call(
        name="grasp_robocasa_object",
        object_name=obj_name,
        evidence_handles=[ev],
        grasp_approach="near_side",
        grasp_wrist_yaw_offset_rad=0.0,
        offset=[0.0, 0.0, -0.05],
        horizon=120

    if r_g.ok and r_g.output.get("grasped"):
        held_h = r_g.output.get("held_object_handle")
        g_ref = primitives.call(name="ground_robocasa_visual_target", entity_name=ref_obj)
        ev_place = [g_ref.output["evidence_handle"]] if g_ref.ok else [ev]
        primitives.call(
            name="place_robocasa_object_at",
            object_name=obj_name,
            held_object_handle=held_h,
            evidence_handles=ev_place,
            target_position=target_pos,
            relation="on",
            horizon=150
        )
